summary: Woman dropped off Sat 2022-09-10 to camp in Dream Canyon was reported missing ~12:47 a.m. Mon 2022-09-12; ground searchers located her ~10:30 a.m. Monday near Boulder Creek above Boulder Falls: she had slipped while climbing a rock Sunday evening, fell and sustained serious injuries, then became disoriented in the darkness and sheltered at a tree; rescuers conducted a complex technical evacuation to the Boulder Falls Trailhead, and AMR took her to a hospital (BCSO case 22-04556)
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain Rescue Group, Boulder County Sheriff's Office, Boulder Emergency Squad, Front Range Rescue Dogs, Sugarloaf Fire Protection District, American Medical Response
wx_note: ERA5 archive 0.25° grid (Open-Meteo); coord basis: county (Boulder County, Colorado, United States)
